title: Classify Job 1121242 as a relative-path launch failure and authorize one exact Route167 retry
scope: one technical replacement of the same train-only clean-off Route167 data collection; no new route selection, corruption, optimization, held-out evaluation, or control intervention

superseded_running_attestation.reason: Job 1121242 is terminal FAILED and never parsed the route XML

terminal_job.failure_stage: RouteIndexer XML parse before any route was loaded
terminal_job.classification: invalid technical launch; not a model, route-safety, U, R, language, planning, or coverage result

root_cause_and_fix.root_cause: submit_scenario_factory_batch.sh exported dirname(batch_manifest) without canonicalizing it; the evaluator changed its working directory before RouteIndexer opened the XML
root_cause_and_fix.fix: canonicalize the batch directory with cd plus pwd -P before exporting PILOT_ROUTE_DIR

regression_test.assertion: a relative manifest invocation from another working directory exports an absolute PILOT_ROUTE_DIR

metadata_changes: new run-id and output paths preserve the failed artifacts instead of overwriting them
source XML now points to the hash-identical frozen local copy
protocol lineage now points to the dedicated Stage2L v12 train-coverage-repair protocol rather than the general scenario-factory protocol

post_run_gates: terminal Slurm state and exit code
at least three CAM_BACK_RIGHT-positive geometry frames
separate Stage1 extraction and QA construction
aggregate CPU coverage gate before any R-only GPU smoke
claim_boundary: This amendment authorizes one technical replacement only. A successful replay remains non-held-out train-only data acquisition and cannot establish R, U, language, planning, closed-loop, or safety performance.
